// Sample generated program: append the new passenger to the vehicle that
// would pick them up soonest. Self-contained; no imports, no host access.
interface Stop {
  requestId: string;
  kind: "pickup" | "dropoff";
  nodeId: string;
  plannedArrivalTimeMs: number;
}
interface Candidate {
  id: string;
  vehicleId: string;
  stops: Stop[];
}
interface Observation {
  stateVersion: number;
  decisionRequestId: string;
  candidates: Candidate[];
}

function pickupTime(candidate: Candidate, requestId: string): number {
  const stop = candidate.stops.find((s) => s.requestId === requestId && s.kind === "pickup");
  return stop ? stop.plannedArrivalTimeMs : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
}

function isAppend(candidate: Candidate): boolean {
  const n = candidate.stops.length;
  return candidate.id === `${candidate.vehicleId}:${n - 2}:${n - 1}`;
}

function decide(observation: Observation) {
  const appends = observation.candidates.filter(isAppend);
  const pool = appends.length > 0 ? appends : observation.candidates;
  let best: Candidate | undefined;
  for (const candidate of pool) {
    if (!best || pickupTime(candidate, observation.decisionRequestId) < pickupTime(best, observation.decisionRequestId)) {
      best = candidate;
    }
  }
  if (!best) {
    throw new Error("no candidates");
  }
  return {
    kind: "chooseCandidate",
    schemaVersion: "bus20-action/1",
    stateVersion: observation.stateVersion,
    candidateId: best.id,
  };
}
